mechanism: Execute the existing nine-command attention-prelude ICB and six-command full-indexer transform ICB through one direct Metal compute encoder, with a resource-scoped memory barrier between the two indirect command buffers. Shared-indexer layers retain their single nine-command replay.

scope.wait_count_claim: UNCHANGED: grouped pre-score replay remains inside the existing token command buffer and commit boundary.

group_execution_contract.cross_graph_dependency: A resource-scoped Metal memory barrier covers the deduplicated union of resources declared by both graphs before the second ICB executes.
group_execution_contract.resource_declaration: Duplicate GPU addresses are coalesced and their read/write usage bits are combined before useResource calls.
group_execution_contract.ledger_accounting: All fifteen semantic dispatches retain their explicit AttentionAndIndexShare attribution.
group_execution_contract.trace_policy: Off and aggregate CPU-encode modes are admitted; split and production per-dispatch GPU trace modes continue to fail closed.
group_execution_contract.fallback: If the full-indexer transform graph is unavailable, a deferred prelude graph executes before the ordinary direct indexer transforms.

bounded_host_encode_benchmark.timed_region: Host encoding only; TokenCommandBuffer creation and GPU commit/wait are outside each sample.
bounded_host_encode_benchmark.workload: Fifteen gravity_zero_f32 indirect commands at 257 elements, with dependency barriers; direct, split 9+6, grouped 9+6, and physically fused 15 variants use the same indirect command count where applicable.

regression_validation.parallel_suite_observation: One process-global expert-wave environment-flag assertion raced during a parallel full-library run; the isolated test and deterministic serial full-library rerun both passed.

qualified: Two dependency-ordered ICBs can execute through one direct Metal compute encoder with exact cross-graph visibility.
Full-indexer layers now remove one direct pre-score encoder without changing the fifteen indirect commands, one-submit topology, outputs, discrete decisions, or waits.
The bounded target-Mac host-encoding benchmark shows lower p50 and p95 sequencing time for grouped 9+6 replay than split 9+6 replay.
not_qualified: The bounded zero-kernel host-encoding benchmark is not an end-to-end token, latency, TPS, TTFT, energy, or production speedup claim.
One exact active-length DSA score dispatch remains direct between grouped pre-score replay and the seven-command post-score replay.
Post-score attention, expert-wave, and final-head graphs remain separate replay calls at their existing semantic boundaries.
No sealed Math-Preserve, sustained-context, memory-pressure, swap, or thermal validation occurred because valid MOP clearance is absent.
qualification.next_boundary: Measure complete bounded-token MetalEncode and wall-time distributions for direct versus fully replayed attention, expert, and head flags; retain default-off status unless replicated end-to-end evidence clears the project ship gate.
